entry.name: midiflush
entry.digest: Send MIDI note-offs for hanging note-ons
entry.description: Analyzes a raw MIDI stream (from midiin or seq), counting the number of note-ons received for each note and MIDI channel. When it is sent a bang, MIDI note-off messages are sent for any notes which have not been turned off.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Whenreceives a, it outputs MIDI note-off messages for all note-ons which have not been matched by note-offs since the object was created (or the lastmessage was sent).

messages.name: clear
messages.description: Erases any note-ons held by, without sending any note-offs.

messages.name: int
messages.description: Raw MIDI data from a source such asorwill be passed through unchanged, while the object observes which note-on messages on each channel have not received matching note-off messages.
